verdict.rationale: Bitbucket offers no native project boards in the evidence. Its planning story is a built-in Jira UI for managing Jira issues inside Bitbucket, plus automatic issue-status updates from commit keys and opening Jira tickets from PRs. That means planning depends on Jira as a separate product, and boards and roadmaps are never mentioned. missing for 10: native project boards, roadmap-level planning views, evidence of board/roadmap functionality within the Jira UI, independent or hands-on corroboration.
